- Pizza slice, about 120 g and 300 kcal
- Tempeh pieces, about 70 g and 130 kcal
- Cauliflower, about 70 g and 18 kcal
- Kale salad, about 60 g and 40 kcal
- Spinach and arugula, about 40 g and 10 kcal
- Broccoli, about 40 g and 14 kcal
- Dressing and oil on the greens, which adds roughly 40 kcal

The mass comes to about 400 g and the energy to about 550 kcal. I rounded both up slightly to 420 g and 560 kcal.
